title: Resend Geek command using the command GUID from Get Command Status (Geek Plus missed request recovery)
summary: Use the command GUID shown in the live “Get Command Status” view to call the ResendGeekCommand function, which resends the request to Geek Plus. This is intended for recovery when Geek Plus may have missed the request after an unplanned restart.
when_to_use: When Geek Plus may have missed a command request after an unplanned restart, and you need to resend that Geek command using the command GUID visible in the live Get Command Status area.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the resend by using the command GUID from the live Get Command Status view and invoking ResendGeekCommand; verify the command status view reflects the resend attempt.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (Get Command Status / Get AGV Status view)
OptiSweep / WCS API via API client (ResendGeekCommand)

access_required: Access to the live RMS / fleet status UI area that includes “Get Command Status”
system_preconditions: A command GUID is available in the live Get Command Status view

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Get AGV status / command status area and the statement that ResendGeekCommand requires a command GUID and that the main GUID is visible in GET command status.

steps.title: Open the live Get Command Status area and locate the command GUID
steps.purpose: The resend function requires a command GUID; the live Get Command Status view provides the visible identifier (main GUID/command GUID).
steps.instruction: In the live RMS / fleet status UI, open the area that includes “Get Command Status” (within the Get AGV status/command status view) and locate the main GUID / command GUID shown there.
steps.expected_result: A command GUID (main GUID/command GUID) is visible in the Get Command Status view.
steps.healthy_condition: The Get Command Status view shows a valid main GUID/command GUID value that can be used for the resend.
steps.failure_condition: The command GUID is missing, blank, or cannot be identified in the Get Command Status view.

actions.label: Locate command GUID in Get Command Status
actions.exact_action: Open the live Get AGV Status / command status area that includes “Get Command Status” and shows the main GUID/command GUID.

stop_or_escalate_if: Command GUID is not available in Get Command Status

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Geek command requires a command GUID from the command database model… You can also see that in the GET command status there is the main GUID as well.”

steps.title: Invoke ResendGeekCommand using the command GUID
steps.purpose: ResendGeekCommand resends the Geek Plus request using the command GUID.
steps.instruction: Using the OptiSweep / WCS API client workflow, call ResendGeekCommand and provide the command GUID you identified from Get Command Status.
steps.expected_result: ResendGeekCommand is executed for the selected command GUID.
steps.healthy_condition: The resend call is issued with the same command GUID that is shown in Get Command Status.
steps.failure_condition: ResendGeekCommand cannot be executed due to a missing/invalid GUID, or the resend call is not issued for the intended GUID.

actions.label: Call ResendGeekCommand with command GUID
actions.exact_action: Invoke the live ResendGeekCommand action/function using that command GUID.

stop_or_escalate_if: ResendGeekCommand cannot be executed due to missing/invalid GUID

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “ResendGeekCommand: Requires a … command guid. It will resend the request to Geek+.”
“Geek command requires a command GUID from the command database model… It will… resend their request to Geek Plus.”

steps.title: Verify command status reflects the resend attempt
steps.purpose: Confirm the resend attempt is observable in the live command status/response area for the same GUID.
steps.instruction: Return to the live Get Command Status / command status view and observe for evidence that the resend was issued for the same command GUID (e.g., updated GET command status fields associated with that GUID).
steps.expected_result: The Get Command Status / command status view reflects the resend attempt for the same command GUID.
steps.healthy_condition: Command status/response fields for the same GUID show an observable update consistent with the resend attempt.
steps.failure_condition: No observable change appears in the command status for the same GUID after the resend attempt, and the AGV remains in an error/stuck condition.

actions.label: Check Get Command Status update
actions.exact_action: Observe the live command status/response area for evidence that the resend was issued (e.g., updated GET command status showing the GUID and/or updated status fields).

stop_or_escalate_if: Command status does not reflect the resend attempt for the same GUID
AGV remains in an error/stuck condition

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Helpful in the event of an unplanned restart and Geek+ missed the request.”
“You can also see that in the GET command status there is the main GUID as well.”

success_criteria: ResendGeekCommand is executed using the command GUID from Get Command Status
Get Command Status / command status view shows an observable update for the same command GUID after the resend attempt
healthy_conditions: Get Command Status shows a valid main GUID/command GUID
After calling ResendGeekCommand, the command status view reflects the resend attempt for that GUID
failure_conditions: Command GUID is not available in Get Command Status
ResendGeekCommand cannot be executed due to missing/invalid GUID
No observable change in command status for the same GUID after resend attempt
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the command GUID is not available in Get Command Status or if the resend does not result in any observable change in command status for the same GUID.
